skills.perk.gathering.vein.8: Breaking an ore takes up to 8 more of its vein
skills.perk.gathering.vein.24: Breaking an ore takes up to 24 more of its vein
skills.perk.gathering.vein.64: Breaking an ore takes up to 64 more of its vein
skills.perk.gathering.timber.32: Breaking a tree's log with an axe takes up to 32 more logs
skills.perk.gathering.timber.256: Breaking a tree's log with an axe takes the whole tree (256 logs)
skills.perk.gathering.leaves: A felled tree's leaves fall at once, with their saplings and apples
skills.perk.gathering.harvest.3: A right-click harvests the ripe crops in a 3×3 square
skills.perk.gathering.harvest.5: A right-click harvests the ripe crops in a 5×5 square
skills.perk.gathering.bag: What a vein, a tree or a harvest drops goes straight into your inventory
skills.perk.gathering.smelt: Mined ores drop their smelted result and the furnace's experience (sneak to skip)
skills.perk.gathering.plant.3: Seeds on farmland plant the empty farmland in a 3×3 square
skills.perk.gathering.plant.5: Seeds on farmland plant the empty farmland in a 5×5 square
skills.perk.gathering.plant.field: Seeds on farmland plant the whole field
skills.perk.gathering.ranch.3: Feeding or shearing one animal does the same kind within 3 blocks
skills.perk.gathering.ranch.5: Feeding or shearing one animal does the same kind within 5 blocks
skills.perk.gathering.ranch.7: Feeding or shearing one animal does the same kind within 7 blocks
skills.perk.gathering.fishing: A bite lands the catch in your inventory and brings the bobber back
skills.perk.gathering.saplings: A sapling lying on grass or dirt for 5 seconds plants itself, one per 2 blocks
